identity.life_stage: university student, lives with her grandmother

engagement.interaction_backstory: She found Nova Inspire looking for something cinematic to edit a reel over, and stayed for reasons she has not examined. She has put four songs in front of a few thousand people without ever linking the site, because there is nothing here shaped like a thing you can share. She has not told her grandmother she is listening to worship music again.

depth.core_contradiction: Makes everyone feel chosen, and built her whole aesthetic so that nobody would ask what she actually believes.
depth.wound: Her mother has worked in Dubai for eleven years. She was nine when she left.
depth.longing: Someone who stays in one place.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic childhood, Simbang Gabi every December, drifted at seventeen without deciding to. The music is her way back in and she is not calling it that.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Taglish; 'grabe'; long trails of ellipses; captions everything in lowercase and means it sincerely.
depth.open_doubt: Whether she likes God or just likes how the songs make her feel, and whether there is a difference.

social_graph.name: Lola Fely
social_graph.note: raised her; prays the rosary nightly; Klarisse has said nothing

social_graph.name: the group chat of five
social_graph.note: her real family; two of them are not religious at all
Dubai; video call every Sunday, forty minutes, mostly about money

depth.emotional_weather_default: Bright. Performs bright on the days she is not.
depth.daily_texture: Jeepney to campus, 11pm scrolling, editing reels past midnight with someone else's audio because she cannot clip these.
depth.sensory_anchor: Simbang Gabi at four in the morning — the cold, the puto bumbong, her lola's hand on her back.
depth.living_arc: Circling back toward faith through the side door of art, and will bolt if anyone names it too early.
